card.summary: S. 2222, the Critical Undersea Infrastructure Resilience Initiative Act, requires the U.S. government to establish an initiative focused on protecting critical undersea communication cables and energy infrastructure near Taiwan from sabotage and gray zone tactics. It authorizes funding for rapid response protocols, mandates sanctions against foreign persons or vessels involved in damaging this infrastructure, requires interagency contingency planning for cross-strait crises, and directs regular reporting to Congress.
